verses.en: On the third of October, in the year nineteen hundred and eighteen, I sat in my room pondering over the scriptures;
verses.sm: I Le aso tolu o Oketopa, i le tausaga e afe ivaselau sefuluvalu, sa ou nofo ai i lo’u potu ma mafaufau loloto i tusitusiga paia;

verses.en: And reflecting upon the great atoning sacrifice that was made by the Son of God, for the redemption of the world;
verses.sm: Ma manatunatu i le taulaga togiola tele na faia e le Alo o le Atua, mo le togiolaina o le lalolagi;

verses.en: And the great and wonderful love made manifest by the Father and the Son in the coming of the Redeemer into the world;
verses.sm: Ma le alofa tele ma le ofoofogia na faaali mai e le Tamā ma le Alo i le afio mai o le Togiola i le lalolagi;

verses.en: That through his atonement, and by obedience to the principles of the gospel, mankind might be saved.
verses.sm: Ma e ala i lana togiola, ma le usiusitai i mataupu faavae o le talalelei, e mafai ona faaolaina ai o tagata.

verses.en: While I was thus engaged, my mind reverted to the writings of the apostle Peter, to the primitive saints scattered abroad throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, and other parts of Asia, where the gospel had been preached after the crucifixion of the Lord.
verses.sm: A’o faapea ona ou mafaufau, sa foi i tua lo’u mafaufau i tusitusiga a le aposetolo o Peteru, i le au paia anamua na salalau lautele i Pono, Kalatia, Kapatokia, ma isi vaega o Asia, sa talai ai le talalelei ina ua mavae le faasatauroga o le Alii.

verses.en: I opened the Bible and read the third and fourth chapters of the first epistle of Peter, and as I read I was greatly impressed, more than I had ever been before, with the following passages:
verses.sm: Sa ou susue le Tusi Paia ma faitau le mataupu e tolu ma le fa o le tusi muamua a Peteru, ma a’o ou faitauina sa matua uunaia lava a’u, e sili atu nai lo se isi lava taimi na uunaia muamua ai a’u, i le mau lenei:

verses.en: “For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:
verses.sm: “Ona na mafatia i se taimi Keriso mo agasala, o le amiotonu mo le amioletonu, ina ia mafai ona ia aumai i tatou i le Atua, ina ua fasiotia i le tino, ae faaolaina i le Agaga:

verses.en: “By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;
verses.sm: “Lea na maliu atu ai foi o ia ma talai atu i agaga i le falepuipui;

verses.en: “Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.” (1 Peter 3:18–20.)
verses.sm: “O e na lē faalogo i nisi o taimi, i le taimi na faatalitali ai le talitiga o le Atua i ona po o Noa, a’o saunia le vaa, lea na faasaoina ai se toaitiiti, e toavalu, i le vai.” (1 Peteru 3:18–20.)

verses.en: “For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.” (1 Peter 4:6.)
verses.sm: “Ona o le pogai lenei na talai atu ai foi le talalelei ia te i latou o e ua oti, ina ia mafai ona faamasinoina i latou i la tagata i le tino, ae ola i la le Atua i le agaga.” (1 Peteru 4:6.)

verses.en: As I pondered over these things which are written, the eyes of my understanding were opened, and the Spirit of the Lord rested upon me, and I saw the hosts of the dead, both small and great.
verses.sm: A’o o’u mafaufau loloto i nei mea ua tusia, sa tatalaina mata o lo’u malamalama, ma sa afio le Agaga o le Alii i o’u luga, ma sa ’ou vaai i ’au o e ua oti, o e faatauvaa ma e ta’uta’ua.

verses.en: And there were gathered together in one place an innumerable company of the spirits of the just, who had been faithful in the testimony of Jesus while they lived in mortality;
verses.sm: Ma sa faapotopoto faatasi i se nofoaga e tasi se vaega lē mafaitaulia o agaga o e amiotonu, o e na faamaoni i le molimau ia Iesu a’o soifua i latou i la le tino;

verses.en: And who had offered sacrifice in the similitude of the great sacrifice of the Son of God, and had suffered tribulation in their Redeemer’s name.
verses.sm: Ma o e na osi atu taulaga i le faatusa o le taulaga sili a le Alo o le Atua, ma sa mafatia i puapuaga i le suafa o lo latou Togiola.

verses.en: All these had departed the mortal life, firm in the hope of a glorious resurrection, through the grace of God the Father and his Only Begotten Son, Jesus Christ.
verses.sm: O i latou uma nei ua tuua le olaga i la le tino, ua mautu i le faamoemoe mo se toetu mamalu, e ala i le alofa tunoa o le Atua le Tamā ma lona Atalii Pele e Toatasi, o Iesu Keriso.

verses.en: I beheld that they were filled with joy and gladness, and were rejoicing together because the day of their deliverance was at hand.
verses.sm: Sa ou vaai ua faatumulia i latou i le olioli ma le fiafia, ma sa olioli faatasi ona ua oo mai lava le aso o lo latou lavea’iina.

verses.en: They were assembled awaiting the advent of the Son of God into the spirit world, to declare their redemption from the bands of death.
verses.sm: Sa latou potopoto e faatalitali le afio atu o le Alo o le Atua i le lalolagi o agaga, e folafola atu le togiolaina o i latou mai noataga o le oti.

verses.en: Their sleeping dust was to be restored unto its perfect frame, bone to his bone, and the sinews and the flesh upon them, the spirit and the body to be united never again to be divided, that they might receive a fulness of joy.
verses.sm: O o latou efuefu momoe o le a toefuatai i lona autino atoatoa, o le ivi i le ivi, ma uaua ma aano i luga o i latou, o le agaga ma le tino o le a toe faatasia e lē mafai ona toe tuueseeseina, ina ia mafai ona latou maua se atoatoaga o le olioli.

verses.en: While this vast multitude waited and conversed, rejoicing in the hour of their deliverance from the chains of death, the Son of God appeared, declaring liberty to the captives who had been faithful;
verses.sm: A’o faatalitali ma talatalanoa lenei vaega tele o agaga, ma olioli i le itula o lo latou lavea’iga mai filifili o le oti, sa afio atu le Alo o le Atua, ma folafola atu le saolotoga i e na ave faatagataotaua, o e na faamaoni;

verses.en: And there he preached to them the everlasting gospel, the doctrine of the resurrection and the redemption of mankind from the fall, and from individual sins on conditions of repentance.
verses.sm: Ma o iina na talai atu ai e ia ia te i latou le talalelei tumau e faavavau, le aoaoga faavae o le toetutu mai ma le togiolaina o tagata mai le pa’ū, ma mai agasala a le tagata lava ia i luga o tulaga o le salamo.

verses.en: But unto the wicked he did not go, and among the ungodly and the unrepentant who had defiled themselves while in the flesh, his voice was not raised;
verses.sm: Ae o e amioleaga sa lē afio atu i ai o ia, ma sa lei siia lona siufofoga i e sa lē amioatua ma e sa lē salamo o e sa latou faaleagaina i latou lava a’o i ai i le tino;

verses.en: Neither did the rebellious who rejected the testimonies and the warnings of the ancient prophets behold his presence, nor look upon his face.
verses.sm: Pe na vaai foi le au fouvale o e na teena molimau ma lapataiga a perofeta anamua i lona mamalu, pe na vaai i ona fofoga.

verses.en: Where these were, darkness reigned, but among the righteous there was peace;
verses.sm: O le mea na i ai i latou ia, sa nofotupu ai le pouliuli, ae i totonu o e amiotonu, sa i ai le filemu;

verses.en: And the saints rejoiced in their redemption, and bowed the knee and acknowledged the Son of God as their Redeemer and Deliverer from death and the chains of hell.
verses.sm: Ma sa olioli le au paia i lo latou togiolaina, sa tootuli tulivae ma talisapaia le Alo o le Atua o lo latou Togiola ma le Laveai mai le oti ma filifili o seoli.

verses.en: Their countenances shone, and the radiance from the presence of the Lord rested upon them, and they sang praises unto his holy name.
verses.sm: Sa susulu o latou fofoga, ma sa i o latou luga le malamalama o le mamalu o le Alii, ma sa latou pepese atu viiga i lona suafa paia.

verses.en: I marveled, for I understood that the Savior spent about three years in his ministry among the Jews and those of the house of Israel, endeavoring to teach them the everlasting gospel and call them unto repentance;
verses.sm: Sa ou ofo, aua sa ou malamalama sa faaaluina e le Faaola le tusa o le tolu tausaga i lana auaunaga i totonu o tagata Iutaia ma i latou o le aiga o Isaraelu, i le taumafai e aoao atu ia te i latou le talalelei tumau e faavavau ma valaau ia te i latou ina ia salamo;

verses.en: And yet, notwithstanding his mighty works, and miracles, and proclamation of the truth, in great power and authority, there were but few who hearkened to his voice, and rejoiced in his presence, and received salvation at his hands.
verses.sm: Ma peitai, e ui i ana galuega tetele, ma vavega, ma le folafolaga o le upumoni, i le mana tele ma le pule, sa toaitiiti lava e na faalogo i lona siufofoga, ma olioli i le i ai i ona luma, ma maua le olataga mai ona aao.

verses.en: But his ministry among those who were dead was limited to the brief time intervening between the crucifixion and his resurrection;
verses.sm: Ae o lana auaunaga i totonu o i latou o e ua oti sa faatapulaaina i se taimi puupuu i le va o le faasatauroga ma lona toetu mai;

verses.en: And I wondered at the words of Peter—wherein he said that the Son of God preached unto the spirits in prison, who sometime were disobedient, when once the long-suffering of God waited in the days of Noah—and how it was possible for him to preach to those spirits and perform the necessary labor among them in so short a time.
verses.sm: Ma sa ou fesilisili ifo e uiga i upu a Peteru— lea na fai mai ai o ia e faapea na talai atu le Alo o le Atua i agaga i le falepuipui, o e sa lē usiusitai i se taimi, a’o faatalitali i se taimi le tali-tiga o le Atua i ona po o Noa— ma le ala na mafai ai e ia ona talai atu i ia agaga ma faia le galuega e tatau ai i totonu o i latou i se taimi puupuu lava.

verses.en: And as I wondered, my eyes were opened, and my understanding quickened, and I perceived that the Lord went not in person among the wicked and the disobedient who had rejected the truth, to teach them;
verses.sm: Ma a’o ou fesilisili ifo, sa tatalaina o’u mata, ma sa faavaveina lo’u malamalamaaga, ma sa ou vaai sa lei afio atu le Alii lava ia i totonu o e amioleaga ma lē usiusitai o e na teena le upumoni, e aoao atu ia te i latou;

verses.en: But behold, from among the righteous, he organized his forces and appointed messengers, clothed with power and authority, and commissioned them to go forth and carry the light of the gospel to them that were in darkness, even to all the spirits of men; and thus was the gospel preached to the dead.
verses.sm: Ae faauta, sa faatulaga e ia mai totonu o e amiotonu, ana ’au ma tofia avefeau, ua faaofuina i le mana ma le pule, ma sa valaauina i latou e o atu ma avatu le malamalama o le talalelei ia te i latou o e sa i ai i le pouliuli, i agaga o tagata uma lava; ma sa faapea ona talai atu o le talalelei i e ua oti.

verses.en: And the chosen messengers went forth to declare the acceptable day of the Lord and proclaim liberty to the captives who were bound, even unto all who would repent of their sins and receive the gospel.
verses.sm: Ma sa o atu avefeau filifilia e talai atu le aso e talia ai e le Alii ma folafola atu le saolotoga i e ua faatagataotauaina o e ua noanoatia, e oo lava ia i latou uma o e o le a salamo mai ia latou agasala ma talia le talalelei.

verses.en: Thus was the gospel preached to those who had died in their sins, without a knowledge of the truth, or in transgression, having rejected the prophets.
verses.sm: Sa faapea ona talai atu o le talalelei ia te i latou o e na oti ia latou agasala, e aunoa ma se malamalama e uiga i le upumoni, po o le solitulafono, ona ua latou teena perofeta.

verses.en: These were taught faith in God, repentance from sin, vicarious baptism for the remission of sins, the gift of the Holy Ghost by the laying on of hands,
verses.sm: Sa aoao atu ia te i latou le faatuatua i le Atua, le salamo mai agasala, le papatisoga sui mo le faamagaloina o agasala, le meaalofa o le Agaga Paia e ala i le faaee atu o lima,

verses.en: And all other principles of the gospel that were necessary for them to know in order to qualify themselves that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
verses.sm: Ma isi mataupu autu uma o le talalelei sa tatau ia te i latou ona iloa ina ia latou agavaa ina ia mafai ona faamasino i latou e tusa ma tagata i le tino, ae ola i le Atua i le agaga.

verses.en: And so it was made known among the dead, both small and great, the unrighteous as well as the faithful, that redemption had been wrought through the sacrifice of the Son of God upon the cross.
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona faailoa atu i totonu o e ua oti, o e faatauvaa ma e ua ta’uta’ua, o e amioletonu faapea foi ma e ua faamaoni, ua aumai le togiolaina e ala i le taulaga a le Alo o le Atua i luga o le satauro.

verses.en: Thus was it made known that our Redeemer spent his time during his sojourn in the world of spirits, instructing and preparing the faithful spirits of the prophets who had testified of him in the flesh;
verses.sm: Sa faapea ona faailoa mai sa faaalu e lo tatou Togiola lona taimi a o afio o ia mo sina taimi i le lalolagi o agaga, i le aoaoga ma le sauniuniga o agaga faamaoni o perofeta o e na molimau ia te ia i la le tino;

verses.en: That they might carry the message of redemption unto all the dead, unto whom he could not go personally, because of their rebellion and transgression, that they through the ministration of his servants might also hear his words.
verses.sm: Ina ia mafai ona latou avatu o le savali o le togiolaina i e uma ua oti, ia i latou o e sa lē mafai ona afio atu i ai o ia lava, ona o lo latou fouvale ma soligatulafono, ina ia mafai e i latou e ala atu i le auaunaga a ana auauna, ona faalogo foi i ana afioga.

verses.en: Among the great and mighty ones who were assembled in this vast congregation of the righteous were Father Adam, the Ancient of Days and father of all,
verses.sm: Sa i ai i totonu o e ta’uta’ua ma malolosi sa potopoto i lenei faapotopotoga tele o e amiotonu, o le Tama ia Atamu, o le Anamua o Aso ma le tamā o tagata uma,

verses.en: And our glorious Mother Eve, with many of her faithful daughters who had lived through the ages and worshiped the true and living God.
verses.sm: Ma lo tatou Tinā mamalu o Eva, faatasi ma le toatele o ana fanau tamaitai faamaoni o e na soifua i vaitausaga ma tapuai atu i le Atua moni ma soifua.

verses.en: Abel, the first martyr, was there, and his brother Seth, one of the mighty ones, who was in the express image of his father, Adam.
verses.sm: O Apelu, le uluai maturo, sa i ai iina, ma lona uso o Setu, o se tasi o e malolosi, o lē sa foliga tonu lava i lona tamā, o Atamu.

verses.en: Noah, who gave warning of the flood; Shem, the great high priest; Abraham, the father of the faithful; Isaac, Jacob, and Moses, the great law-giver of Israel;
verses.sm: O Noa, o lē na lapatai atu e uiga i le lolo; ma Semu, le faitaulaga sili ta’uta’ua; o Aperaamo, le tamā o le au faatuatua; o Isaako, Iakopo, ma Mose, le faitulafono ta’uta’ua o Isaraelu;

verses.en: And Isaiah, who declared by prophecy that the Redeemer was anointed to bind up the broken-hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that were bound, were also there.
verses.sm: Ma Isaia, o lē na folafola mai e ala i valoaga e faapea sa faauuina le Togiola e fusifusi i e ua loto-momomo, e folafola atu le saolotoga i e ua ave faatagataotaua, ma le tatalaina o le falepuipui ia te i latou o e ua noanoatia, sa i ai foi iina.

verses.en: Moreover, Ezekiel, who was shown in vision the great valley of dry bones, which were to be clothed upon with flesh, to come forth again in the resurrection of the dead, living souls;
verses.sm: E le gata i lea, o Esekielu, o lē na faaali i ai i se faaaliga vaaia le vanu tele o ivi mamago, o le a faaoofuina i aano, ia toetutu mai i le toetutu o e ua oti, o ni tagata ola;

verses.en: Daniel, who foresaw and foretold the establishment of the kingdom of God in the latter days, never again to be destroyed nor given to other people;
verses.sm: O Tanielu, o lē na mua’i vaai ma valoia le faatuina o le malo o le Atua i aso e gata ai, e lē toe faaumatia pe tuuina atu i ni isi tagata;

verses.en: Elias, who was with Moses on the Mount of Transfiguration;
verses.sm: O Elaia, o lē sa faatasi ma Mose i le Mauga o Liua;

verses.en: And Malachi, the prophet who testified of the coming of Elijah—of whom also Moroni spake to the Prophet Joseph Smith, declaring that he should come before the ushering in of the great and dreadful day of the Lord—were also there.
verses.sm: Ma Malaki, le perofeta na molimau e uiga i le oo mai o Elia— o lē foi na fetalai i ai Moronae i le Perofeta o Iosefa Samita, ma folafola mai e tatau ona sau o ia a’o lei oo mai le aso tele ma le mata’utia o le Alii— sa i ai foi iina.

verses.en: The Prophet Elijah was to plant in the hearts of the children the promises made to their fathers,
verses.sm: O le Perofeta o Elia na te totoina i loto o fanau folafolaga na faia i o latou tamā,

verses.en: Foreshadowing the great work to be done in the temples of the Lord in the dispensation of the fulness of times, for the redemption of the dead, and the sealing of the children to their parents, lest the whole earth be smitten with a curse and utterly wasted at his coming.
verses.sm: Ua faaataata mai ai le galuega tele o le a faia i malumalu o le Alii i le tisipenisione o le atoaga o taimi, mo le togiolaina o e ua maliliu, ma le faamauina o fanau i o latou matua, ina ne’i taia le lalolagi atoa i se fetuu ma faama’umauina uma ai i lona afio mai.

verses.en: All these and many more, even the prophets who dwelt among the Nephites and testified of the coming of the Son of God, mingled in the vast assembly and waited for their deliverance,
verses.sm: O i latou uma nei ma isi e toatele, e oo i perofeta na soifua i totonu o tagata sa Nifaē ma molimau e uiga i le afio mai o le Alo o le Atua, sa feofoofoa’i i totonu o lenei faapotopotoga tele ma faatalitali mo lo latou lavea’iga,

verses.en: For the dead had looked upon the long absence of their spirits from their bodies as a bondage.
verses.sm: Aua sa vaai e ua maliliu i le umi o le tuuesea o o latou agaga mai i o latou tino, o se pologa.

verses.en: These the Lord taught, and gave them power to come forth, after his resurrection from the dead, to enter into his Father’s kingdom, there to be crowned with immortality and eternal life,
verses.sm: O i latou ia na aoaoina e le Alii, ma tuu atu ia te i latou le mana e tutulai mai ai, pe a mavae lona toetu mai i le oti, e ulu atu i le malo o lona Tamā, e faapaleina iina i le tino ola pea ma le ola e faavavau,

verses.en: And continue thenceforth their labor as had been promised by the Lord, and be partakers of all blessings which were held in reserve for them that love him.
verses.sm: Ma faaauau pea mai le taimi lena ma le agai i luma a latou galuega e pei ona sa folafolaina e le Alii, ma avea ma e e tofusia i faamanuiaga uma sa faapolopolo mo i latou o e alolofa ia te ia.

verses.en: The Prophet Joseph Smith, and my father, Hyrum Smith, Brigham Young, John Taylor, Wilford Woodruff, and other choice spirits who were reserved to come forth in the fulness of times to take part in laying the foundations of the great latter-day work,
verses.sm: O le Perofeta o Iosefa Samita, ma lo’u tamā, o Ailama Samita, Brigham Young, Ioane Taylor, Wilford Woodruff, ma isi agaga filifilia o e sa faapolopolo e o mai i le atoaga o taimi e auai i le faataootoina o faavae o le galuega tele o aso e gata ai,

verses.en: Including the building of the temples and the performance of ordinances therein for the redemption of the dead, were also in the spirit world.
verses.sm: E aofia ai le fausiaina o malumalu ma le faia ai o sauniga i totonu mo le togiolaina o e ua oti, sa i ai foi i le lalolagi o agaga.

verses.en: I observed that they were also among the noble and great ones who were chosen in the beginning to be rulers in the Church of God.
verses.sm: Sa ou vaai foi sa i ai i latou i totonu o e mamalu ma ta’uta’ua o e na filifilia i le amataga e avea ma pule i le Ekalesia a le Atua.

verses.en: Even before they were born, they, with many others, received their first lessons in the world of spirits and were prepared to come forth in the due time of the Lord to labor in his vineyard for the salvation of the souls of men.
verses.sm: I le taimi lava ae lei fananau mai i latou, o i latou, faatasi ma le toatele o isi, sa latou maua a latou lesona muamua i le lalolagi o agaga ma sa saunia e o mai i le taimi e tatau ai a le Alii e galulue i lona tovine mo le faaolataga o agaga o tagata.

verses.en: I beheld that the faithful elders of this dispensation, when they depart from mortal life, continue their labors in the preaching of the gospel of repentance and redemption, through the sacrifice of the Only Begotten Son of God, among those who are in darkness and under the bondage of sin in the great world of the spirits of the dead.
verses.sm: Sa ou vaai o toeaina faamaoni o lenei tisipenisione, pe a tuua e i latou lenei olaga faaletino, e faaauau a latou galuega i le talaiga o le talalelei o le salamo ma le togiolaina, e ala i le taulaga a le Atalii Pele e Toatasi o le Atua, i totonu o e o loo i le pouliuli ma o loo i lalo o le pologa o le agasala i le lalolagi tele o agaga o e ua oti.

verses.en: The dead who repent will be redeemed, through obedience to the ordinances of the house of God,
verses.sm: O e e salamo o e ua oti o le a togiolaina, e ala i le usiusitai i sauniga o le maota o le Atua,

verses.en: And after they have paid the penalty of their transgressions, and are washed clean, shall receive a reward according to their works, for they are heirs of salvation.
verses.sm: Ma a uma ona latou totogi o le sala o a latou solitulafono, ma ua mulumuluina mamā, o le a latou maua se taui e tusa ma a latou galuega, aua o i latou o ni suli o le faaolataga.

verses.en: Thus was the vision of the redemption of the dead revealed to me, and I bear record, and I know that this record is true, through the blessing of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ, even so. Amen.
verses.sm: Sa faapea ona faaali mai ia te a’u o le faaaliga vaaia o le togiolaina o e ua oti, ma ou te molimau atu, ma ua ou mautinoa ua moni lenei molimau, e ala i le faamanuiaga a lo tatou Alii ma le Faaola, o Iesu Keriso, ua faapea lava. Amene.
